title: 第16章 风城往事十六第17章 风城往事十七
slug: 天神传说第438章改革开始
content_zh:
“李掌柜，风城很少禁娱，今日是为何？”苏鸿章问道。
“这……苏少爷，咱们还是先吃饭吧。”李成指了指眼前的饭菜。
“掌柜，这可有流食？”苏鸿章道。
“有，一会就来了。”李成道。
苏鸿章见状也不好多说什么，只能陪着李成一起心不在焉的吃着。
“二少爷，您这一路坎坷啊。”李成道。
“你与李叔是兄弟，想来你也知道些内幕。”苏鸿章放下筷子道。
“嗯。”李成点了点头。
“苏鸿成那个畜牲，已经回来了吧。”苏鸿章道。
“额，嗯，已经回来了。”李成犹豫了一下回道。
铛铛铛。
“掌柜，人来了，还有流食。”
“进来吧。”
门打开，李鹏走了进来，小二把流食放下便离去了
“少爷，真的是你！”李鹏哭丧着脸跪在苏鸿章面前。
“李叔，你这是干什么，快起来。”苏鸿章连忙扶起李鹏。
“少爷，我对不起你啊。”李鹏跪在地上抱着苏鸿章痛哭。
“李叔，怎么了，我爹呢。”苏鸿章道。
“老爷他，他被苏鸿成，杀了！”
苏鸿章如遭雷击似的愣在原地，许久仍未回过神。

“不可能，我爹的修为在风城也能排进前三，他苏鸿成受了伤，修为也没父亲高，怎么可能杀的了父亲！”苏鸿章抓住李鹏的衣领喊道。
“苏少爷，控制你的情绪！”李成拉开苏鸿章。
“李鹏，说假话是要付出代价的！”苏鸿章喊道。
“少爷，我李鹏用生命起誓，我所言句句属实。”
“那你告诉我，苏鸿成是如何杀的父亲！”
“苏鸿成给老爷下了五年的九幽散魂香，老爷修为尽失，被苏鸿成一剑，穿脖颈而过，至今日，已是七天了！”
苏鸿章呆呆的站在原地。
“原来，今日禁娱，是因为……
下一秒，苏鸿章便两眼一闭，倒了下去。
“少爷！”
苏家，会客厅。
“柳妈，天儿呢？”苏鸿成坐在主椅上揉着脑袋。
“回老爷，从今天早上就没见过。”柳妈道。
“这混小子，回来必须给他点教训。”苏鸿成怒道。
“爹，我可不敢要这教训。”苏天从门口走进来，嘴中还叼着一根草。
“把那根草吐了，一天天的，没个正形”苏鸿成气道。
“那苏少卿也天天叼着草，你咋不说他呢？”苏天顶嘴道。
苏鸿成愤怒的举起手便要打下，幸得柳妈及时制止。
“少爷，快把草吐了吧，莫惹老爷生气了。”柳妈道。
苏天不情愿的将草吐掉。

“你记住，我做的一切都是为了让你超越它，而不是成为它，你自己好好想想吧。”苏鸿成说完，愤怒的离去。
content_en:
"Shopkeeper Li, entertainment is rarely prohibited in Fengcheng. Why is it today?" Su Hongzhang asked.
"This...Master Su, let's eat first." Li Cheng pointed to the food in front of him.
"Shopkeeper, is there any liquid food here?" Su Hongzhang asked.
"Yes, I'll be here soon," Li Cheng said.
Su Hongzhang didn't know what to say when he saw this, so he could only eat absentmindedly with Li Cheng.
"Second Young Master, your journey has been bumpy," Li Cheng said.
"You and Uncle Li are brothers. I guess you also know some inside information." Su Hongzhang put down his chopsticks and said.
"Yeah." Li Cheng nodded.
"That beast Su Hongcheng is back, right?" Su Hongzhang said.
"Uh, um, I'm back already." Li Cheng hesitated and replied.
Clang clang clang.
"Shopkeeper, we are here, and there is liquid food."
"Come in."
The door opened and Li Peng walked in. The waiter put down the liquid food and left.
"Master, it's really you!" Li Peng cried and knelt in front of Su Hongzhang.
"Uncle Li, what are you doing? Get up quickly." Su Hongzhang quickly helped Li Peng up.
"Master, I'm sorry for you." Li Peng knelt on the ground and hugged Su Hongzhang, crying bitterly.
"Uncle Li, what's wrong? Where is my father?" Su Hongzhang said.
"Master, he was killed by Su Hongcheng!"
Su Hongzhang froze on the spot as if struck by lightning, and he still didn't recover for a long time.
"Impossible, my father's cultivation is ranked among the top three in Fengcheng. Su Hongcheng was injured and his cultivation is not as high as his father's. How could he kill his father!" Su Hongzhang grabbed Li Peng's collar and shouted.
"Master Su, control your emotions!" Li Cheng pulled Su Hongzhang away.
"Li Peng, you have to pay a price for telling lies!" Su Hongzhang shouted.
"Master, I, Li Peng, swear on my life that everything I say is true."
"Then tell me how Su Hongcheng killed his father!"
"Su Hongcheng gave me the Nine Nether Soul Dispersing Incense for five years. My cultivation was completely lost. Su Hongcheng pierced my neck with a sword. It has been seven days since then!"
Su Hongzhang stood there blankly.
"It turns out that entertainment is banned today because...
The next second, Su Hongzhang closed his eyes and fell down.
"Master! "
Su family, living room.
"Mother Liu, where is Tian'er? "Su Hongcheng sat on the main chair and rubbed his head.
"Sir, I haven't seen you since this morning. "Liu Ma said.
“This bastard must be taught a lesson when he comes back. "Su Hongcheng said angrily.
"Dad, I don't dare ask for this lesson. "Su Tian walked in from the door with a piece of grass in his mouth.
"Spit up that piece of grass, day by day, I'm not in the right shape," Su Hongcheng said angrily.
"Then Su Shaoqing is holding grass in his mouth every day, why don't you talk about him? "Su Tian retorted.
Su Hongcheng raised his hand angrily and was about to strike it down, but fortunately Liu Ma stopped him in time.
"Master, spit out the grass quickly, don't make the master angry. "Liu Ma said.
Su Tian reluctantly spit out the grass.
"Remember, everything I do is to make you transcend it, not become it, think about it yourself. "After Su Hongcheng finished speaking, he left angrily.
